title: Listings in Quarto
text:
A Quarto Listing creates an index of related pages. It is useful for a portfolio because each project can be stored in its own file while Quarto automatically organizes the collection.


Listings help visitors:

Scan several projects quickly
Filter projects by category
Read a short description before opening a page
Find the most recent work first




The listing on this page is created with the following YAML:
listing:
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  fields: [title, description, date, categories]
  sort: "date desc"
  filter-ui: [categories]
The contents option tells Quarto to read pages from the projects/ folder. The other options control the layout, displayed metadata, sorting, and filtering.



Each project page can contain front matter like this:
---
title: "Avenue Shabu: Growth in Repeat Guests"
description: "A CRM and customer analytics project about profitable repeat visits."
date: 2026-10-23
categories: [CRM, retention, customer analytics]
---
Adding another project only requires adding another QMD file to the projects/ folder.

section: 2.1 Avenue Shabu Digital Marketing and CRM Strategy
text:
2.1 Avenue Shabu Digital Marketing and CRM Strategy

Managerial problem: Avenue Shabu needs to connect its digital marketing and CRM activities to customer visits, repeat visits, and revenue.
Target audience: Avenue Shabu’s owner and marketing team.
Objective: Develop a digital marketing, CRM, and loyalty strategy that supports profitable repeat visits.
Methods and impact: Conduct a channel audit, customer-lifecycle planning, and campaign measurement analysis to improve marketing decisions and support the loyalty program launch.

2.2 Wellness Ranch Therapy Digital Marketing Project

Data and sources: Wellness Ranch project materials, website and marketing information, and available enrollment or retention data.
Managerial problem: Wellness Ranch needs to improve awareness, customer engagement, and enrollment or retention.
Target audience: Wellness Ranch leadership and marketing decision makers.
Objective: Identify marketing opportunities that can improve customer acquisition and engagement.
Methods and impact: Analyze target audiences, digital channels, and customer behavior to recommend practical marketing improvements.

title: Portfolio Website Project Proposal
section: 3.1 Avenue Shabu Loyalty Program Results and GA4 Analysis
text:
3.1 Avenue Shabu Loyalty Program Results and GA4 Analysis

Data and sources: Toast customer and transaction data, loyalty enrollment and redemption data, email/SMS campaign data, and GA4 website data.
Managerial problem: Avenue Shabu needs to determine whether the loyalty program and digital channels are increasing customer engagement and repeat visits.
Target audience: Avenue Shabu’s owner, marketing manager, and operations team.
Research questions: Which customer segments return more frequently? Does loyalty enrollment relate to repeat visits? Which website channels and actions support marketing goals?
Methods and impact: Use customer segmentation, retention analysis, loyalty results, GA4 traffic and conversion analysis, and campaign comparisons to evaluate program performance and recommend improvements.

title: Portfolio Website Project Proposal
text:
3.2 Walmart Sales Prediction Project

Data and sources: Historical Walmart sales data and related time-based or economic variables.
Managerial problem: Walmart needs accurate sales predictions to support inventory, staffing, and operational planning.
Target audience: Retail managers, sales planners, and operations teams.
Objective: Predict future sales and identify factors associated with changes in demand.
Methods and impact: Use exploratory analysis, regression, time-series forecasting, and forecast accuracy measures to support better business planning.
